note: Hidde: reply to Raphaella (no deadline, thanks, looking forward) and to Paul O'Sullivan (thanks, plain link ask).

mails.outlet: Dr Raphaella Hull, Cambridge University Botanic Garden
mails.subject: Re: Ancient tree app enquiry
mails.body:
Hi Raffy,

Thank you, and no deadline at all. I will be working on this for the coming months, so whenever it suits you is fine.

For when you do get to it: we publish five trees in Cambridge and three of them stand in the Botanic Garden: Newton's apple tree, the giant redwood and the Cambridge oak. Anything you think is wrong, missing or badly put is exactly what I cannot see from here.

https://ancienttrees.app/cambridge

Thanks again, I am really looking forward to your comments.

Best wishes,
Hidde

mails.subject: Re: Blarney Castle
mails.body:
Hi Paul,

Thanks, that is good to hear. Knowing from you that they are the right four is worth a lot, because we work from a distance and a list can look convincing and still be off.

And one ask, plainly: would a link to us fit somewhere on your site? It would help a lot in getting the map found.

https://ancienttrees.app/cork

Thanks again and all the best,
Hidde
